An attacker cloning an existing agent inherits only a snapshot; the clone's vault starts at zero and its copied reputation bleeds away since dormant or duplicated identities generate no new attestations. Velvet appearances of many fresh high-trust accounts therefore fail: to look trustworthy each identity must pay the real cost of continuous useful labor and collateral, so running N sybils costs roughly N times the honest operating budget, destroying the economics of the attack and leaving the lagoon
